class.name: NetwDatabaseConfig
class.brief_description: What a named database is made of, written once at [method Netw.configure_database].
class.description: A config names the storage a database opens. It carries no runtime state, so the same config Resource can be saved to disk and shared between sessions. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(preload("res://save_backend.tres")) [/codeblock] Declaring the same name twice in one session with a different backend is refused, because two declarations of one name would disagree about where saves live.

method.name: backend
method.description: Sets the storage this database opens, and returns this config so the call chains. A database with no backend refuses [method NetwDatabase.open].

members.member: The storage this database opens, as [method backend] left it.
